prompt:
Create EIGHT distinctly different key poses of one full natural walking cycle for this SAME adult 3D woman in SHORT-SLEEVE ivory/navy sports top and MID-THIGH SHORTS, ankle socks and trainers. All look SIDEWAYS TO THE RIGHT. 4 COLUMNS, 2 ROWS, wide canvas, all full bodies equal scale with 15% transparent margins.
Read each cell precisely. TOP ROW cell1: NEAR leg straight diagonally forward, FAR leg diagonally back, heel strike. Cell2: NEAR foot planted under front of hip and FAR knee bent strongly behind, far heel clearly lifted. Cell3: passing position BOTH KNEES NEXT TO EACH OTHER UNDER HIP, far shin angled back and far foot airborne; NOT a wide split stance. Cell4: FAR knee moving in front of body, NEAR straight support leg under hip.
BOTTOM ROW cell1: FAR leg stretched diagonally FORWARD and NEAR leg stretched diagonally BACK, opposite of first cell. Cell2: FAR foot planted forward and NEAR knee bent behind, near heel lifted. Cell3: passing position knees NEXT TO EACH OTHER directly under hips, NEAR shin angled back and near foot airborne. Cell4: NEAR knee moving ahead and FAR support leg under hip ready for first pose. All noses and shoes oriented right, hair trails left. Arms reverse their front/back swing exactly at the second row. At least FOUR of the EIGHT cells must have one knee bent and the two feet close together horizontally; do NOT draw eight duplicated wide strides. Preserve both leg attachments and separate feet, no floating leg fragments. Actual transparent background no aura/text/numbers/floor.
